title: The exact region determined by Kendall's tau, Spearman's footrule and Blomqvist's beta
summary: We determine the exact region $Ω_{τ,φ,β}:=\{(τ(C),φ(C),β(C)):C\in\mathcal{C}\}$ of possible joint values of Kendall's tau, Spearman's footrule and Blomqvist's beta over the class $\mathcal{C}$ of all bivariate copulas. The region consists precisely of all triples $(t,p,b)$ satisfying $-1\le b\le 1$, $\frac{3}{16}(1+b)^2-\frac12\le p\le 1-\frac38(1-b)^2$ and $\frac43 p-\frac13\le t\le \frac23 p+\frac13$.
